entries.title: Revelation of John 9:1
segments: ¶Then the fifth angel sounded: And I saw a star fallen from heaven to the earth. To him was given the key to the bottomless pit.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:2
segments: And he opened the bottomless pit, and smoke arose out of the pit like the smoke of a great furnace. So the sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke of the pit.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:3
segments: Then out of the smoke locusts came upon the earth. And to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:4
segments: They were commanded not to harm the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only those men who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:5
segments: And they were not given [authority] to kill them, but to torment them [for] five months. Their torment [was] like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a man.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:6
segments: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:7
segments: The shape of the locusts was like horses prepared for battle. On their heads were crowns of something like gold, and their faces [were] like the faces of men.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:8
segments: They had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like lions' [teeth].

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:9
segments: And they had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings [was] like the sound of chariots with many horses running into battle.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:10
segments: They had tails like scorpions, and there were stings in their tails. Their power [was] to hurt men five months.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:11
segments: And they had as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in Hebrew [is] Abaddon, but in Greek he has the name Apollyon.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:12
segments: One woe is past. Behold, still two more woes are coming after these things.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:13
segments: ¶Then the sixth angel sounded: And I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:14
segments: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:15
segments: So the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, were released to kill a third of mankind.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:16
segments: Now the number of the army of the horsemen [was] two hundred million; I heard the number of them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:17
segments: And thus I saw the horses in the vision: those who sat on them had breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of the horses [were] like the heads of lions; and out of their mouths came fire, smoke, and brimstone.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:18
segments: By these three [plagues] a third of mankind was killed--by the fire and the smoke and the brimstone which came out of their mouths.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:19
segments: For their power is in their mouth and in their tails; for their tails [are] like serpents, having heads; and with them they do harm.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:20
segments: But the rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and idols of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:21
segments: And they did not repent of their murders or their sorceries or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
